scope.included: All non-scenario Great Works created by Great Writers, Great Artists, Great Musicians, plus Sun Tzu’s The Art of War, for Civilization VI Anthology with New Frontier Pass/Babylon Pack enabled.
excluded: Jadwiga’s Legacy scenario-only artists and works
Artifacts, Relics, Products, and other Great Work classes not created by the requested Great People

globalNotes: The nine Babylon Pack creators are normal Great People and are not gated by the Heroes & Legends mode.
Rise and Fall and Gathering Storm add no additional Great Writers, Great Artists, or Great Musicians beyond the base roster; the only DLC additions in this scope are the nine Babylon Pack creators.
Era is the in-game recruitment era, not necessarily the creator’s historical period.
There are no exact-string duplicate work titles among the 166 records; anthology/contained-work and series-level overlaps are documented in notationNotes.
Current displayed English strings are authoritative for workTitle even when a real-world identity or audio asset disagrees.
